'''Dossiers''' are a drop from [[Yama]]. They can be opened to obtain a [[Yama#Contracts|contract]], [[chasm teleport scroll]]s, or a [[rite of vile transference]]. The Rite of Vile Transference is guaranteed from the first Dossier opened with at least 100 Yama kill count.

==Drops==
{{DropLogProject|jagex=yes}}

{{Average drop value|mobname=dossier|killname=opening}}

Excluding the [[Contract of Oathplate Acquisition]], the average dossier opening is worth {{Coins|floor(({{Average drop value|mobname=dossier|raw=y}}-{{GEP|Contract of Oathplate Acquisition}}*(13/1740)))}}.
